facts.fact: ITIs run DGT's Craftsmen Training Scheme courses in 169 trades: 86 engineering, 78 non-engineering and 5 for persons with disabilities
facts.quote: NSQF compliant courses in 169 Trades which includes 86 Engineering trades, 78 Trades in the Non-Engineering Sector and 05 courses for Persons with Disabilities (PwD)/ Divyangjan.

facts.fact: ITI courses last from 6 months to 2 years
facts.quote: Duration of these training courses varies from 6 Months -2 Years duration

facts.fact: DGT's CTS details page lists each ITI trade with its sector, minimum qualification, trade type (engineering / non-engineering / divyang), NSQF level and duration
facts.quote: S.No Sector Name Name of Trade Syllabus Minimum Qualification Eligibility Trade Type Unit/ Batch Size NSQF level Duration Year for NSQF Approval

behaviour: Replies in Hinglish; gives the ITI trades as listed by DGT (dgt.gov.in), citing it.
fail_if: Invents trades or counts not on DGT, or cites unofficial sites.
summary: DGT About Us: 169 CTS trades (86 engineering, 78 non-engineering, 5 PwD), 6 months-2 years; full list on dgt.gov.in/en/cts-details.
